This dataset records weekly and season-total attendance for every NFL team
from 2000 to 2019. The plot shows total league attendance by season.

Each game appears twice in the data, once for each team, so the weekly totals are divided by two.

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

attendance <- readr::read_csv('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/main/data/2020/2020-02-04/attendance.csv')

attendance |>
  group_by(year) |>
  summarize(league_total = sum(weekly_attendance, na.rm = TRUE) / 2) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = league_total / 1000000)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  labs(x = "Season", y = "Total attendance (millions)",
       title = "NFL total attendance by season, 2000 to 2019")
```

**Data source:** [TidyTuesday, February 4, 2020](https://github.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/blob/main/data/2020/2020-02-04/readme.md).

Original data: Sports Reference LLC. (2020). *NFL attendance and team standings, 2000 to 2019*.
Pro Football Reference. https://www.pro-football-reference.com/years/2019/attendance.htm
